capabilities: Scan skill folders (SKILL.md format) and subagent definition folders into a catalog
Serve an ARD registry over localhost HTTP with bearer-token endpoints
Rank skills by natural-language search and facet exploration
Expose an MCP endpoint with sandboxed JavaScript execution against the catalog
Serve skill and subagent file bodies directly to requesting agents
disambiguation: It doesn't run agents or chat with your notes; it only publishes and serves a searchable catalog of skill files that other agents fetch.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalog; manual build and install required. Desktop-only (needs Node HTTP server and filesystem access). Detailed user and technical docs live outside the README. The default BM25 search needs no model or network and works offline.
motivation: Built for people who have accumulated dozens or hundreds of AI Skills and don't want to register everything everywhere — publish them to a local catalog and let agents search it.
problem: Agents that use many AI skills and MCP servers must load them all into context; there is no local registry they can search to fetch only the skill they need.
